name: Proposal Acceptance Auto-Onboarding
description: When a proposal becomes accepted (client response or admin inline), an async task provisions the client's platform project: creates the project/phase, mirrors the functional_requirements items as ProjectScopeItem rows, and upserts Kanban Requirement cards from the technical_document, linked to their scope item. Idempotent (runs once) and preserves client-owned Kanban state on re-sync. Backend-triggered; not a browser E2E journey.
